scope: Engineering supervision and logging reliability;2epoch smoke only

coverage.note: Coverage means no missing interval longer than0.5s;10Hz cannot establish instantaneous extrema. Regular sample intervals are not continuous measurement.

known_limits: User linger=no: not guaranteed across full logout/reboot
SIGKILL of both services or power/filesystem failure can prevent final status; absence must be treated as unknown
0.1s sampling and0.5s gap threshold are not hard realtime or instantaneous peak guarantees
Generic command daemonization/child group escape unsupported; official run_sim exec path verified
Smoke does not establish long run reliability or policy performance
